Supports 1952 arrival with family,1953 Wawadiťła opening/pole/potlatch, Henry/David/Tony Hunt collaboration,1957 commission and 1958 presentation,1962 death and 1970 memorial. Birth heading 1881 conflicts with the stated death age83 and TCE 1879. No exact birth year, absolute first-public-potlatch claim or survey of all crests is asserted.
